headline: Jayshree Tea & Industries Limited: Promoter Share Acquisition under PIT Regulations
sum: Jayshree Tea & Industries disclosed a promoter acquisition of shares under PIT (Prohibition of Insider Trading) regulations. The disclosure was filed with NSE on 20 August 2026; specific acquisition value and share count were not detailed in the headline announcement.
implication: Promoter acquisitions under PIT require contemporaneous exchange disclosure to signal insider confidence and satisfy regulatory transparency; this filing confirms the company's compliance with NSE Listing Rules and SEBI's insider trading framework.
detail: Jayshree Tea & Industries Limited, listed on NSE, informed the exchange of a promoter share acquisition triggered under PIT (Prohibition of Insider Trading) regulations. The disclosure appears in the NSE corporate filing archive as a PIT Form 20 (or equivalent insider disclosure). Such acquisitions typically signal promoter confidence and are subject to SEBI's Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015, which mandate disclosure within two trading days of the transaction. The specific acquisition quantum, consideration, and timeline were not provided in the headline; further details would require review of the full PIT disclosure form.

framework.ref: SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015 (PIT Regulations)
framework.note: Central regulation governing disclosure of transactions by insiders (including promoters) in securities of listed companies; mandates Form B filing within two trading days of acquisition.

framework.ref: NSE Listing Rules, Schedule B & Clause 36
framework.note: Exchange listing standards requiring listed companies to disclose insider transactions and maintain disclosure records; sets timeline and format for PIT filings.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992
framework.note: SEBI's primary statutory mandate for securities market regulation and enforcement of insider trading rules.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: Material event and transaction disclosure rules; insider acquisitions may qualify as material for separate disclosure to exchanges.
